test_coverage_notes: SignerListSet is a core transaction type in rippled. Typical test coverage is found in unit tests under 'src/test/app/SignerListSet_test.cpp', 'src/test/app/SetSignerList_test.cpp', or similar. These tests usually cover valid/invalid quorum, malformed signer entries, duplicate signers, invalid flags, and edge cases (e.g., removing signer list, setting with zero quorum, etc.). Gaps may exist in protocol rule transitions (e.g., fixInvalidTxFlags), malformed STArray structures, or rare edge cases (e.g., maximum signer entries, boundary quorum values). Integration tests may not cover all malformed transaction scenarios or protocol upgrades.
